{07 14 00}Thanks again for agreeing
to go bug-to-bug with me,
{04 1f 00}.
{07 00 00}Looks like nobody can beat
you! {01 00 00 05 00}You're, like, the
bugmeister of bugsburg!

you, {04 1f 00}. You are
{04 03 00}'s champion!

{07 0f 00}I can't believe you beat me,
{04 1f 00}. I spent all
this time for nothing{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Well, I guess I shouldn't
complain. I got to see a
bug master in action.
{07 14 00}I'm just glad I had the
chance to witness your
awesome bugging skills.
{07 1a 00}{0b 03 00}{04 03 00}'s lucky to have
someone with your talent
